notes.note_1: All 29 requested blockchains have fallback icons generated due to network/source availability issues.
notes.note_2: To populate this report with real data, run: npm run fetch-icons
notes.note_3: The pure Node.js fetcher (fetch-icons-pure.js) includes exponential backoff retry logic and alternative name mapping.
notes.note_4: Fuzzy matching uses string-similarity with threshold of 0.78 (78% similarity) to match canonical names to source filenames.
notes.note_5: All fallback SVGs are valid and render correctly; they consist of a colored circle with the first letter of the blockchain name.
